calculation_handling.description: A parking space inside a building (not an ancillary building) may be converted to interior floor area for a use under 10.40.20.100(19) or (20), with no replacement parking required, if the space is in a residential building other than an apartment building (and (B)-(F) are met).
calculation_handling.gaps: Conversion of existing parking to a non-residential use is outside the MaxBLD build scenario.

units.disclosure: An indoor parking space in a house may be converted to certain non-residential uses without replacement parking, subject to conditions. We do not evaluate this conversion.

evidence.garage_entrance_faces_street: vehicle entrance to the parking space is in the front main wall

calculation_handling.description: Condition of the conversion: the vehicle entrance to the parking space is in the front main wall of the building.

Condition of the conversion: the driveway to the vehicle entrance is removed and any front-yard depression is filled to established grade. Keyed REQUIRE with the nearest requirement token (landscaping_type); the obligation is driveway removal and regrading.
calculation_handling.gaps: No requirement token names driveway removal exactly.

calculation_handling.description: The removed driveway area in the front yard must be landscaping, but may still count as a permitted driveway when calculating required soft landscaping under 10.5.50.10(1)(D).

evidence.parking_space: a parking space located in the front yard

calculation_handling.description: A parking space in the front yard or a street-side side yard must be subject to 10.5.80.10(3) or be authorized by a Section 45 minor variance.
Regulation 200.5.10.11(1)(C) does not apply to the parking space being converted. Displaces 200.5.10.11(1)(C) for that space.

10.40.80.1(1).explanation: In the RS zone, an indoor parking space in a house (not an apartment building) may be converted to floor area for certain non-residential uses, with no replacement parking required. The garage door must be on the front wall. The driveway must be removed and landscaped, and the ground filled to grade. Any front-yard parking must be legal or approved by a minor variance.
